units.source_text: 千重子把凝望着树上紫花地丁的目光移到下方，直勾勾地盯着基督像。

en.t: Chieko lowered her gaze from the violet flowers on the tree and stared fixedly at the statue of Christ.

units.source_text: 她虽然没有念过教会学校，但喜欢英语，常常进出教堂，也读读《圣经》新约和旧约。

en.t: Although she had never attended a church school, she liked English, often went in and out of churches, and also read parts of the New Testament and the Old Testament of the Bible.

units.source_text: 可是要给这个古老的灯笼献把花束，或点根蜡烛，她就觉得不合适。

en.t: But offering a bouquet to this old lantern, or lighting a candle for it, seemed improper to her.

units.source_text: 因为灯笼上哪儿也没有雕上十字架。

en.t: For there was no cross carved anywhere on the lantern.
